stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 3.

Original towns and villages are found along the National Road, many barely touched by the passing of time.

In this quotation, the author's use of figurative language contributes to the meaning of the article by —

options.label: A
options.text: indicating that the National Road prevented progress along its route

options.label: B
options.text: conveying that the National Road gave the surrounding area protected status

options.label: C
options.text: suggesting that towns along the National Road have older populations

options.label: D
options.text: emphasizing that some towns along the National Road have remained unchanged

visual_elements: quotation box containing italicized text: Original towns and villages are found along the National Road, many barely touched by the passing of time.
